title: AlphaWiSE: Adaptive Weight Interpolation for Continual Multimodal Representation Learning
abstract: arXiv:2607.15094v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Multimodal retrieval models align audio, images, and text in a shared embedding space, but sequential adaptation can degrade cross-modal relationships learned in earlier phases. Existing continual-learning procedures produce a single final checkpoint, so every retrieval direction shares the same stability-plasticity trade-off. We introduce AlphaWiSE, a post-hoc weight-space interpolation method that combines a sequential fine-tuning endpoint with a companion endpoint obtained with a stability-oriented continual-learning method. AlphaWiSE fits one scalar interpolation coefficient for each corresponding parameter tensor on an exemplar memory while both endpoints remain frozen. The interpolated tensors are then materialized into a single checkpoint, so the deployed model retains the architecture and inference cost of a single backbone. translated_title: AlphaWiSE：面向持续多模态表征学习的自适应权重插值方法
translated_abstract: 多模态检索模型在共享嵌入空间中对齐音频、图像和文本，但顺序适应可能会降低早期阶段学习到的跨模态关系。现有的持续学习流程只产生单一的最终检查点，因此每个检索方向都共享相同的稳定性-可塑性权衡。我们提出了AlphaWiSE，这是一种事后权重空间插值方法，它将顺序微调端点与通过面向稳定性的持续学习方法获得的伴随端点相结合。AlphaWiSE在示例记忆上为每个对应的参数张量拟合一个标量插值系数，同时两个端点保持冻结。插值后的张量随后被物化为单一检查点，因此部署的模型保留了单一骨干网络的架构和推理成本。在持续的音频-图像-文本检索任务中，融合模型优于其两个端点中较好的那个。
tldr: AlphaWiSE通过为每个参数张量自适应拟合标量插值系数，将顺序微调端点与稳定性导向端点的权重进行事后融合，在保持单一模型架构和推理成本的同时，提升了持续音频-图像-文本检索的性能。
en_tdlr: AlphaWiSE adaptively fits per-tensor interpolation coefficients to fuse a sequentially fine-tuned endpoint with a stability-oriented endpoint, improving continual multimodal retrieval while retaining a single-backbone architecture and inference cost.
